enzyme-gel-cleanser.descriptor: A fresh start. A smooth finish.
enzyme-gel-cleanser.description: A gel facial cleanser with papaya fruit extract and salicylic acid. Massage onto damp skin and rinse well, morning or evening.
highlights: Papaya fruit extract and salicylic acid
Morning or evening, on damp skin
enzyme-gel-cleanser.title: Begin with a clean, smooth-feeling canvas.
enzyme-gel-cleanser.story: A gel facial cleanser with papaya fruit extract and salicylic acid. Massage onto damp skin and rinse well, morning or evening.

faqs.question: How do I use it?
faqs.answer: Apply a small amount to pre-moistened skin and gently massage. Rinse well with water. May be used twice daily.

faqs.question: Is this the Anti-Aging Cleanser with Peptides?
faqs.answer: No. These are distinct formulas. Enzyme Gel Cleanser contains papaya fruit extract and salicylic acid; the Anti-Aging Cleanser with Peptides remains a separate product. Review each product’s own ingredient list.

faqs.question: Does it contain fragrance?
faqs.answer: Fragrance is not listed as an ingredient. The formula does include orange peel oil, a botanical oil. The complete ingredient list from the approved IQON label is shown on this page.

faqs.question: Can I use it with other exfoliating products?
faqs.answer: The formula lists salicylic acid. If you also use Exfoliating Pads or Retinol Rx, introduce new steps one at a time and stop use if irritation occurs.

benefits.title: A rinse-off gel
benefits.body: Massage a small amount onto damp skin, then rinse well with water.

benefits.title: Papaya fruit extract
benefits.body: Carica papaya fruit extract sits in the formula alongside salicylic acid and glycerin.

benefits.title: Ready for what follows
benefits.body: Clean skin is the starting point for the serum and moisturizer steps that follow.

ingredients.name: Papaya fruit extract
ingredients.detail: The approved ingredient list names Carica Papaya (Papaya) Fruit Extract. It does not specify papain concentration or measured enzyme activity.

ingredients.name: Salicylic acid
ingredients.detail: Salicylic acid is a beta hydroxy acid, or BHA. In a rinse-off cleanser it is in contact with skin briefly before you rinse it away.

ingredients.name: Glycerin
ingredients.detail: Glycerin is a humectant, an ingredient that attracts water. It sits alongside the cleansing ingredients in this gel.

steps.title: Start with damp skin
steps.body: Wet your face before applying the cleanser.

steps.title: Massage gently
steps.body: Work a small amount over the face with your fingertips.

steps.title: Rinse well
steps.body: Rinse thoroughly with water, then continue with your serum and moisturizer.

expectations.title: What should I expect?
expectations.body: A rinse-off gel cleanse for the start or end of your day. Cleansing is one step; how your routine works for you also depends on the steps that follow and on daily sun protection.

guide.title: A clean start, every day.
guide.introduction: A gel cleanser for the first step of your morning or evening routine.

details.title: A good fit if…
details.body: You want a straightforward rinse-off gel to begin your routine before serum and moisturizer.

details.title: What to expect
details.body: A small amount massaged onto damp skin and rinsed away. Use up to twice daily.

details.title: Worth knowing
details.body: The formula lists salicylic acid and orange peel oil. Review the complete ingredient list if you are sensitive to either.

hyaluronic-serum.description: A lightweight aloe-based serum with glycerin, panthenol and sodium hyaluronate, for skin that feels dehydrated. Apply after cleansing, before moisturizer.
hyaluronic-serum.title: Hydration, in a lighter layer.
hyaluronic-serum.story: A lightweight aloe-based serum with glycerin, panthenol and sodium hyaluronate, for skin that feels dehydrated. Apply after cleansing, before moisturizer.

faqs.question: How do I use it?
faqs.answer: After cleansing and toning, apply to entire face and neck. Once absorbed, follow with moisturizer and/or sun protection products (SPF). May be used twice daily.

faqs.question: Does it contain hyaluronic acid?
faqs.answer: It contains sodium hyaluronate, the salt form of hyaluronic acid used in skincare. Aloe leaf and glycerin appear earlier in the ingredient list. The complete ingredient list from the approved IQON label is shown on this page.

faqs.question: Why does the ingredient list include colors?
faqs.answer: Yellow 5 and Blue 1 are color additives listed on the label. The preservatives include phenoxyethanol and methylisothiazolinone. Review the complete list if you avoid any of these ingredients.

faqs.question: Can I use it with another serum?
faqs.answer: This is a hydration-focused step. If you use another serum, follow both labels and introduce new products one at a time. Suitability depends on your skin and the complete routine.

benefits.title: For skin that feels dehydrated
benefits.body: A lightweight serum with humectants, ingredients that attract and hold water.

benefits.title: An aloe-based formula
benefits.body: Aloe barbadensis leaf comes straight after water on the ingredient list, with glycerin and panthenol.

benefits.title: Layers before moisturizer
benefits.body: Apply after cleansing and toning. Once absorbed, follow with moisturizer, and SPF by day.

ingredients.name: Sodium hyaluronate
ingredients.detail: Sodium hyaluronate is the salt form of hyaluronic acid. It binds water at the skin’s surface, helping skin feel hydrated.

ingredients.name: Glycerin
ingredients.detail: Glycerin attracts water and works alongside sodium hyaluronate in this lightweight serum.

ingredients.name: Aloe & panthenol
ingredients.detail: Aloe leaf, panthenol and allantoin are conditioning ingredients that complete the formula, with cucumber, chamomile and ginseng extracts.

steps.title: Cleanse + tone
steps.body: Begin with clean skin, morning or evening.

steps.title: Apply
steps.body: Smooth over the entire face and neck and allow it to absorb.

steps.title: Moisturize + protect
steps.body: Follow with moisturizer, and with sun protection in the morning.

expectations.title: What should I expect?
expectations.body: A light hydration layer. It is designed to sit under your moisturizer, not to replace it, and it does not replace daily sunscreen.

peptide-anti-wrinkle-day-cream.description: A rich morning cream with aloe, sodium hyaluronate, panthenol and squalane, for dull, dry-feeling skin. Follow with sun protection.
peptide-anti-wrinkle-day-cream.title: A richer start to the day.
peptide-anti-wrinkle-day-cream.story: A rich morning cream with aloe, sodium hyaluronate, panthenol and squalane, for dull, dry-feeling skin. Follow with sun protection.

faqs.question: How do I use it?
faqs.answer: Warm a small amount between your fingertips and massage into face, neck and décolleté. Follow with sun protection (SPF) in the morning.

faqs.question: Do I still need sunscreen?
faqs.answer: Yes. The label directs you to follow this cream with sun protection (SPF) in the morning.

faqs.question: Does it contain retinol?
faqs.answer: Retinol is not listed. The formula does list retinyl palmitate, a vitamin A ester. If you also use Retinol Rx or Copper Peptide Restore Cream, consider your whole routine.

faqs.question: Does it contain wheat or fragrance?
faqs.answer: The ingredient list includes hydrolyzed wheat protein and fragrance. The complete ingredient list from the approved IQON label is shown on this page.

benefits.title: Moisture for dry-feeling skin
benefits.body: Aloe leaf, glycerin and sodium hyaluronate bring water-binding care to a rich cream.

benefits.title: A softer, smoother feel
benefits.body: Emollients including squalane and cetyl esters help skin feel soft and look smoother.

benefits.title: Made for mornings
benefits.body: Massage into the face, neck and décolleté, then follow with sun protection.

ingredients.name: Aloe leaf
ingredients.detail: Aloe barbadensis leaf is listed straight after water, forming the base of this cream.

ingredients.name: Sodium hyaluronate & glycerin
ingredients.detail: Both ingredients attract and hold water, helping dry-feeling skin feel more comfortable.

ingredients.name: Squalane
ingredients.detail: Squalane is an emollient that softens the feel of skin. Panthenol, wheat protein and silk amino acids complete the conditioning care.

steps.title: Cleanse + serum
steps.body: Start with clean skin and any serum you use in the morning.

steps.title: Warm + massage
steps.body: Warm a small amount between your fingertips and massage into face, neck and décolleté.

expectations.title: What should I expect?
expectations.body: A moisturizing cream that helps dry-feeling skin feel softer and look smoother. It is a cosmetic step, not a treatment, and daily sun protection remains essential.
